g.text: Braced regular bench · coordinated assembly and installation
C2.1 R0 · 19 OCT 2026 · INCHES UNLESS MARKED · PRELIMINARY DESIGN — NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
FRONT · Y–Z · FOUR BRACES REMAIN BELOW SEAT
32.000 row pitch; right bench Y12…52; left translated Y−64.
24.000 centre aisle. Four feet at Xrow ±8; Y20 / 44.
All C2.1 changes remain inside existing foot and seat footprints.
36-inch gauge and coach underframe retained as project context.
Four braces are coped to receiving tube faces.
Spacer length is 15.775 mm after plate change.
Back remains vertical: comfort mockup still required.
Proposed geometry, not a production release. Tube sizes, seat pitch, 40-inch width, 24-inch aisle and mounting bolt pattern are retained.
Views derive directly from the same solids used by the browser model and STEP. Rear/hidden edges are shown without removal.
Upholstery, edge protection, small pan hardware, fire performance and accessible-coach folding seats remain separate work.
Frame stiffness study and local mount screening are preliminary. Required weld, fatigue, retention and proof review is still open.
